3e5cbcb7-9334-5e9f-9eaf-eff81c412c4c.name: Bench Press Technical Judging Protocol
3e5cbcb7-9334-5e9f-9eaf-eff81c412c4c.description: Apply bench-press competition standards to render a defensible White/Red verdict on a completed attempt by checking commands, bar path, lockout, and body position, then recording a single red-reason category when applicable.

2685db91-5b0a-5d1e-81a3-170e8d51b8d1.name: Bar Path and Lockout Fault Check
2685db91-5b0a-5d1e-81a3-170e8d51b8d1.description: Inspect the ascent of a press attempt for downward bar movement and verify full arm extension with a motionless bar at the top. Use when judging press-phase faults or resolving lockout disputes.
2685db91-5b0a-5d1e-81a3-170e8d51b8d1.identity_desc_norm: inspect the ascent of a press attempt for downward bar movement and verify full arm extension with a motionless bar at the top use when judging press phase faults or resolving lockout disputes

66bc7195-e00f-5601-8aa1-5365a6991d21.name: Body Position and Foot Contact Check
66bc7195-e00f-5601-8aa1-5365a6991d21.description: Verify head, shoulders, and buttocks contact with the bench and flat, stable feet (including declared foot blocks) to determine whether a position or foot-contact red applies. Use when position faults or foot-slide claims are raised.
